name: Midas Fasanara Global
oneLiner: mGLOBAL is a Midas tokenized certificate wrapping Fasanara's global private-credit and strategy portfolio; NAV-accreting, EEA-restricted rails.
collateral: Tokenized exposure to Fasanara's Global Fund (same strategy as the Global Diversified Alternative Debt Fund): an asset-backed lending portfolio investing primarily in short-dated trade receivables and digital invoices purchased from SMEs, held via Midas tokenized-certificate rails.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting Midas tokenized certificate; primary issuance and redemption occur through Midas permissioned rails rather than a fixed $1 peg.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas Attestation Engine: on-chain NAV/proof-of-reserves/price, independently verified via Chainlink, Canary, LlamaRisk and vLayer

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (blockchain-based certificate under German law); EEA-restricted, not available to U.S. retail persons

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas Fasanara Global is a permissioned tokenized certificate with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

notices.title: Contract-priced strategy token
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live price and market cap but little or no secondary-market volume; Pharos treats MGLOBAL as a NAV-priced tokenized certificate.

mintAuthority.summary: mGLOBAL is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy (Ethereum) sharing the same ProxyAdmin (0xbf25b58), MidasTimelockController (0xe3eee3e, 2-day delay), and 1/3 admin Safe (0xb60842e9) as mF-ONE. Minting via DepositVault 0xd36f0955 called by EOA 0x425bbc2c. Same MidasAccessControl 0x0312a9d1.

controls.label: Midas issuance backend EOA (DepositVault operator)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25296044: mint transactions originate from EOA 0x425bbc2cff0c7e7960baa9bac2f0cb67b41d3bef calling DepositVault 0xd36f095556d5717fd9231a2091e8e98beb7cb621 (e.g. tx 0x45c6b143). Issuer-controlled minting only.

controls.label: Midas ProxyAdmin (MidasTimelockController + 1/3 Safe)
controls.evidence: mGLOBAL at 0x7433806912eae67919e66aea853d46fa0aef98a8: EIP-1967 admin slot = 0xbf25b58 (same ProxyAdmin as mF-ONE). ProxyAdmin.owner() = MidasTimelockController 0xe3eee3e (2-day delay). Same 1/3 Safe 0xb60842e9 controls timelock. MidasAccessControl at storage slot 0xc9 = 0x0312a9d1 (same as mF-ONE). Full Safe onchain reads same as mF-ONE entry.
